title.narrative: Strengthened enforcement capacities of public authorities (STEP EU)

description.narrative: Main objectives: 1)Consolidate a comprehensive data landscape for the prevention and early detection of corruption and other financial crimes 2)Strengthen EU Member States’ capacity to detect, investigate and prosecute cross-border corruption3)Enhance the cooperation between competent authorities at a national and regional level Value of the contract is EUR 1,485,093.

participating-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for Migration and Home Affairs (DG HOME)

recipient-region.narrative: The countries involved are Slovenia, Ireland, Italy , Latvia, Portugal, Spain, France, Lithuania, and Germany.
